title: CondoGuard Renewal Conditions
content:
Conditions of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy at the end of each twelve-month term.

**Renewal.** A policy in force and not under a notice of nonrenewal renews for twelve calendar months when renewal installment 1 is paid by the expiration date; otherwise it expires with the reason renewal not paid.

**Inflation guard.** At renewal Coverage A is increased by the tier's inflation guard percent and rounded up to the next 1,000 USD, never above the tier's maximum Coverage A.

**Nonrenewal for claim frequency.** The carrier also nonrenews when the paid-claims count reaches the tier's paid-claims threshold on the notice date, with at least the tier's nonrenewal notice days of notice. The paid-claims count is the number of distinct claim numbers on the customer's CondoGuard policies with at least one claim payment, not voided, in the tier's claims lookback months ending on the notice date. A claim-frequency nonrenewal is never rescinded.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Coverage A before renewal (USD) | Inflation guard | Increased amount (USD) | Rounded up to the next 1,000 USD | Tier maximum (USD) | Coverage A at renewal (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 61500 | 3 percent | 63345 | 64000 | 150000 | 64000 |
| 148000 | 3 percent | 152440 | 153000 | 150000 | 150000 |

A customer with two claims on one CondoGuard policy and one on another, each with a payment in the lookback, has a paid-claims count of 3; one claim with three payments counts once.
